text:
maya: heads-up — rolling a config-only change for a short high-traffic window (marketing blast). no code changes, just routing/limits/batching.
maya: change summary: reduce per-route limit for /v1/generate 120rps -> 90rps, batch_wait 12ms -> 6ms, add enterprise routing pin to fallback pool for isolate spike.
maya: plan: canary 10% @ 11:45, quick check @ 12:00, ramp -> 60% @ 12:05, full @ 12:10. target: reduce p95 tail latency during burst.
deploy-bot: deploy started: config-only rollout id cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt. canary 10% -> eng-canary pool. ETA ~2m.
alex: ack. watching infra dashboards: infra.latency.p95, app.queue_length, errors.rate. alert thresholds: p95 > 800ms or queue > 50 -> escalate.
sam: quick q — fallback pool uses same model build? concerned about output diffs for embed callers.
maya: good Q. fallback uses same model variant (gptx-8q) and same quantization. only shaping/routing differs. outputs should be functionally identical.
luca: please paste rollback command for oncall.
maya: rollback commands:
```
# to rollback via API
curl -X POST "https://deploy.internal/api/v1/rollbacks" -d '{"id":"cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt"}'
# or via bot
deploy-bot rollback cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt
```
Condition to rollback: p95 > 800ms for >5m OR errors spike >2% above baseline for >5m.
oncall-bot: pager rule created: if errors >2% for 10m -> page oncall.
alex: can we pin high-volume tenants out of the canary? we don't want large customers in 10% split.
maya: yes — pinned enterprise routes to fallback. snippet below:
```
routes:
  - match: "/v1/generate"
    rate_limit_per_min: 5400  # 90 rps
    batch_window_ms: 6
    routing_policy:
      enterprise_tag: use_fallback_pool
```
sam: :thumbsup: runbook checks? add quick verification list.
maya: verification checklist:
1) canary group p50/p95 lower or stable vs baseline
2) error rate <= baseline + 0.5%
3) token cost delta < 2%
4) logs show no model-version mismatch for routed requests
alex: i'll watch the dashboards at 11:45 and 12:00. ping me if anything odd.
deploy-bot: Canary applied: 10% traffic to eng-canary pool. rollout id cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt. monitoring hooks active.
luca: if we see degradation, 50% rollback with 30s grace then full rollback is preferred.
maya: timeline recap: 11:45 canary start, 12:00 manual check, 12:05 ramp to 60%, 12:10 finish. keep eyes on p95/error+queue.
sam: do we need a customer ops ping? seems small, so no. i'll message #customer-ops if anything surfaces.
alex: :eyes: watching now.
deploy-bot: Rollout update: ramp to 60% at 12:06 (minor lag). cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 12:12. status: success. cfg-20240411-traffic-sculpt.
maya: closing thread — changes pushed, runbook updated under internal-runbook/traffic-sculpting. thanks all! :tada:
